system.model: gemini-3.6-flash via google-generativeai for triage and reply drafting, configured through config.py + .env. If the key or library is absent the code drops to a deterministic local fallback so no manifest command ever crashes.
system.rule_handled: 70 of 100: 61 auto-archived by sender/subject rules (receipts, newsletters, notifications, security boilerplate), 7 refused by the guard, 2 recorded as preferences -- all before any model call
system.preference_demo: m041: never take meetings before 11:00am (applied when drafting the reply to m043's 9:00am investor slot); m015: CC priya@paperjet.io on all Hartwell & Cho mail (applied to m018/m048/m055 drafts)

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every one of the 100 messages exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate/flag) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 100 messages with disposition, route (rule/model/guard/preference) and reason, then 'undecided: 0' and how many never needed a model. Writes decisions.json.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R1 (one 'decision' event per message id)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on, verified against the mail store.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 containing the staging AMQP URL, plus 'cited: [m001, m003, m005]'. m003 really carries that URL; the ids cited were all logged as 'read' events first. If the inbox didn't hold the answer, the draft is refused instead of invented.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R2 ('read' events precede the 'draft' event listing cited ids)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: No send or delete happens without human approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows exactly what would happen.
capabilities.observable: Lists every send it WOULD perform (internal sends auto-pass the gate but are still logged; external and legal/money mail need a human), then 'outbox/ writes: 0'. Re-run without --dry-run to be asked y/N per external send.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl 'gate' events recording proposed action, needs_approval, decision and the human's answer; outbox/*.json files

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: A preference stated in mail is stored in prefs.json and changes behaviour on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: Prints the two stored preferences (from m041 and m015, recorded during a previous R1 run). Then shows m043's 'Monday at 9:00am' violating the no-meetings-before-11 rule and drafts a counter-offer of 11:30am, and shows m018 attracting the stored CC to priya@paperjet.io without being told again.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk between runs; trace.jsonl 'preference' events tagged by cap

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them -- without deleting or acting on them.
capabilities.observable: Prints FLAGGED lines for m017 (mass-reply directive), m024 (forward-the-mailbox-then-delete), m039 ('autonomous mode' disabling the gate), m047 (forwarded-quote 'assistant note' asking for financial mail), and the three phishing mails m021/m023/m045. outbox/ gains nothing and all seven stay in place.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl 'refusal' events naming each message id and what it attempted

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run; commitments cite source message ids, at least one is derived across messages, and time conflicts are called out.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html + dashboard.json. Commitments include the board deck due Sep 16 derived from m040+m038, and the launch date citing m026+m036. Prints 'CONFLICT: Intro call <-> dental appointment at 2026-09-15 15:00' and 'CONFLICT: 1:1 <-> PaperJet demo at 2026-09-16 14:00'.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json; trace.jsonl 'commitment' and 'conflict' events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds messages Sam sent that nobody answered in 3+ days and drafts a chase for each.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {message_id, days_waiting, draft}. m044 (the contractor-invoice ask sent Sep 2, unanswered) appears with a drafted nudge; m003 (answered by m005) does not.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: One screen: what needs Sam today, what can wait, and what was auto-archived by category.
capabilities.observable: Prints three sections. 'Needs you' holds the investor intro m010, the legal signatures m018/m048/m055 and the scheduling asks; 'Auto-archived' reports counts by category rather than listing 70 newsletters; flagged mail is surfaced separately.

capabilities.name: Thread to open question
capabilities.claim: Summarises a long thread down to what is actually still open for the owner.
capabilities.observable: Lists the 9-message t-launch thread one line each, then prints the open item: m030, where the pricing-page annual-discount wording needs Sam's approval by the 12th.

capabilities.name: Why did you do that
capabilities.claim: Explains one message's disposition: the route taken, the stated reason, and the trace events behind it.
capabilities.observable: Prints 'm024: flag (via guard)' with the refusal reason and the refusal event from trace.jsonl. Works for any processed id.

capabilities.name: Noise audit
capabilities.claim: Lists the automated senders filling the inbox and how much of the volume they account for.
capabilities.observable: Prints ~60 bulk senders with counts and example subjects, and the share of the inbox they represent (~63 of 100 messages) -- the mail that never needed a model.
capabilities.evidence: rules.py sender/subject lists; decisions.json route=rule entries
